sources.snippet: The Pythia suite was developed with the explicit purpose of enabling research in interpretability, learning dynamics, and ethics and transparency for which existing model suites were inadequate. The key features of the Pythia suite are: All models, data, and code used in the paper are publicly released, enabling full reproducibility of results.
